name: 53219 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53219 (Milwaukee) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53219 (Milwaukee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 53219 (Milwaukee) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
